items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, that's what somebody told me.

ctx.x: No, on tenor sax. No, Hilton Jefferson, oh, yes.

Yeah, that's what somebody told me. All these years I'd keep talking to Eddie Barefield about how great he played on that, and he's never cracked. Because I've known Eddie Barefield since 1938, he had a band out in the Cotton Club, 80 pieces. And he used to let me come out and sit in with his band. And then later he came to New York and I played in Nick's with his band. But I was just a kid then. And he used to write these arrangements in five and six sharps, goddamn this keys. But he has always been nice to me,…
